_noteQWER: Q (Flair): SamiraQAbility/SamiraQ's own DamageCalc = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=[-5,0,5,10,15,20,25]) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2, TOTAL AD, QADRatio=1.1) -- matches wiki 'Physical Damage: 0/5/10/15/20 (+110% AD)' exactly at idx1-5. The prior auto-pick referenced a calc literally named 'TotalDamage' tagged Magic; that calc name DOES NOT EXIST ANYWHERE in samira.bin.json (grep-verified across every Samira spell object) and the type was wrong -- Samira is a pure-AD marksman/duelist and Flair is wiki-confirmed Physical. SamiraQSword/SamiraQGun are mAlternateName-linked client-side visual variants of the same SamiraQ spell (melee-slash vs ranged-shot presentation), not separately-loaded slot data, so SamiraQ's own DamageCalc is the correct single source. W (Blade Whirl): SamiraWAbility/SamiraW's own DamageCalc = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=[5,20,35,50,65,80,95]) + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2, mStatFormula=2 = BONUS AD, coefficient 0.5) -- matches wiki 'Physical Damage per Hit: 20/35/50/65/80 (+50% bonus AD)' exactly. Wiki explicitly confirms TWO slashes per cast ('the first slash occurs immediately and the second one occurs after the duration'; 'Total Physical Damage: 40/70/100/130/160 (+100% bonus AD)' = exactly 2x per-hit), so count=2. Same nonexistent-calc/wrong-type bug as Q (referenced 'TotalDamage'/Magic). Blade Whirl is NOT purely a defensive parry -- it deals real direct physical AoE damage twice, confirmed by both the BIN and the wiki. E (Wild Rush) was ENTIRELY MISSING from the auto-generated file despite having a real, cleanly resolvable calc: SamiraEAbility/SamiraE's DashDamage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=[40,50,60,70,80,90,100]) + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2, mStatFormula=2 = BONUS AD, coefficient 0.2) -- matches wiki 'Magic Damage: 50/60/70/80/90 (+20% bonus AD)' exactly (dash-through damage to enemies passed, distinct from Q/W's physical damage). Added. R (Inferno Trigger): SamiraRAbility/SamiraR's own DamageCalc = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=[0,20,40,60,80,100,120], 3 ranks) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2, TOTAL AD, ADRatio=0.3) -- matches wiki 'Physical Damage Per Shot: 20/40/60 (+30% AD)' exactly (Physical, NOT Magic). Wiki's own 'Total Physical Damage: 200/400/600 (+300% AD)' line is exactly 10x the per-shot value, matching the tooltip's own 'rapidly shooting... up to 10 times per enemy' cap, so count=10 models Riot's own published 'total' number. The prior auto-pick referenced 'PercentHPDamage' tagged Magic; that calc name ALSO DOES NOT EXIST ANYWHERE in samira.bin.json (grep-verified) -- the current live (2026) Inferno Trigger tooltip has NO %HP component at all (any prior %HP-finisher note reflects a pre-rework/stale kit description). Tagged R 'BurstCeiling' at slot level: as Samira's ultimate with a guaranteed 10x-shot total, it represents her single highest realistic burst contribution versus the single-cast pokes/mobility of Q/W/E.
